NUPHY-RELEASE-NOTES 1 version:1.2.52 [zh-CN] NuPhy Lab 1.2.52
• 在功能中心添加「取色器」，点选屏幕颜色即可复制 HEX 色号。可以用一个单键、组合键或鼠标侧键取色。重新录制会替换原键，取色结果会在屏幕顶部短暂显示。 • 语音控制的指令快捷键支持鼠标侧键。点当前键位，再按下并松开想用的侧键。按一次开始说指令，再按一次执行。 • 点键位旁的 × 可以清除指令快捷键。这个选择会在重新打开 NuPhy Lab 后保留，也可以直接点「说指令」使用语音控制。 [en] NuPhy Lab 1.2.52
• Add Color Picker from Feature Center to sample a screen color and copy its HEX code. Set a single key, key combination or mouse side button as your shortcut. Recording again replaces it. The result appears briefly at the top of the screen. • Voice Control supports mouse side buttons. Click the current shortcut, then press and release the side button you want. Press once to speak and again to run the command. • Click × beside the shortcut to clear it. Your choice is saved when you reopen NuPhy Lab. You can still click Speak a command to use Voice Control.
